input: Schedule a professional carpet cleaning for the stairs

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the location (city/area) determines which cleaning companies are available and reachable for the job.
The user's budget range affects which services or tiers of cleaning to consider and shortlist.
The size and number of stair sections affects the quote and which companies can handle the job — e.g., a small home staircase vs. a large multi-flight staircase.
Knowing whether the user already has a preferred company in mind vs. needs help finding one changes the immediate next action entirely.
Whether someone needs to be home during the cleaning affects which appointment slots are feasible.
The carpet type or any specific concerns (stains, allergies, pet hair) influence which cleaning method or chemical treatments to request.
A hard deadline or preferred timeframe for when the cleaning should happen determines urgency and how quickly the booking must be made.

gold.taskTitle: Schedule professional carpet cleaning for the stairs
